2609.10192.title: Who Argues What? Joint Argument-Entity Detection and Classification in Political Debates
2609.10192.paper_summary: Political debates are often analyzed through Argument Mining (AM) to investigate the key arguments that drive them. However, political arguments are rarely interpretable from argumentative spans alone, as claims and premises generally depend on the entities (e.g., people, events, locations, parties) they mention. Existing AM resources and methods typically annotate argumentative spans and roles, but do not provide a paired debate-entity layer for asking which Debate Named Entities (DNE), e.g., actors and events, are invoked within debates. In this work, we address these data and methodological gaps by (i) introducing DNE-ElecDeb, an entity-enriched version of the USElecDeb dataset that adds DNEs in both argumentative and non-argumentative spans and defines Debate Named Entity Recognition (DNER) as the task of detecting DNEs, and (ii) proposing Joint Argument and Entity Tagging (JAET), a generative framework that fine-tunes decoder-only LLMs to insert inline argument and entity tags into debate turns while preserving the original transcript. Under BIO-tagging evaluation, JAET improves relative F1 on the joint AM+DNER task by +27.3%, resp. +41.9%, under the untyped, resp. typed setting over the strongest sequential AM-DNER pipelines, demonstrating that such gains cannot be recovered by composing two independent modules. Notably, similar margins replicate on Persuasive Essays (+26.6%, resp. +52.7%), showing effective generalization to domains orthogonal to political debates. By unifying argumentative and entity-level representations within a single view, our contributions pave the way for richer political debates understanding.
2609.10192.paper_summary_zh: 政治辯論通常通過論證挖掘（Argument Mining, AM）進行分析，以調查驅動這些辯論的關鍵論點。<lb/>然而，政治論點很少僅從論證範圍中解釋，因為主張和前提通常依賴於它們提到的實體（例如，人、事件、地點、政黨）。<lb/>現有的 AM 資源和方法通常標註論證範圍和角色，但不提供配對的辯論-實體層，以詢問在辯論中提及了哪些辯論命名實體（Debate Named Entities, DNE），例如，行動者和事件。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們通過 (i) 引入 DNE-ElecDeb，這是一個增強實體的 USElecDeb 數據集版本，該版本在論證和非論證範圍中添加 DNE，並將辯論命名實體識別（Debate Named Entity Recognition, DNER）定義為檢測 DNE 的任務，以及 (ii) 提出聯合論證和實體標註（Joint Argument and Entity Tagging, JAET），這是一個生成框架，微調僅解碼器的 LLM 以在保留原始記錄的同時將內聯論證和實體標籤插入辯論回合。<lb/>在 BIO 標註評估下，JAET 在聯合 AM+DNER 任務上的相對 F1 提升了 +27.3%，在未類型化和類型化設置下分別為 +41.9%，超過了最強的序列 AM-DNER 管道，顯示這樣的增益無法通過組合兩個獨立模塊來恢復。<lb/>值得注意的是，類似的增益在說服性論文中重複出現（+26.6%，分別為 +52.7%），顯示出對與政治辯論正交的領域的有效泛化。<lb/>通過在單一視圖中統一論證和實體級別的表示，我們的貢獻為更豐富的政治辯論理解鋪平了道路。
